name: THIS DOOR MUST NOT BE OPENED
source:
Among countless lines of code and data, lies an enigmatic program that transcends the boundaries of the ordinary. A hidden girl, concealed within a labyrinth, within a visual novel about the intrinsics of reality and life; nevertheless, not your story, just one you just stumbled upon by chance. Puzzles that require you to think out of the box, thus I will offer you a little hint; this program has end credits.

[from [url=https://purechito.itch.io/thisdoorshouldnotbeopened]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在无数行代码与数据之间，藏着一个超乎寻常的神秘程序。一部视觉小说探问现实与生命的本质，里面有一座迷宫，迷宫中又藏着一个女孩。可这并不是你的故事，你只是碰巧撞见了它。要解开谜题，你得跳出惯常的思路。所以，我给你一个小小的提示：这个程序有片尾字幕。
